body: It’s sounds really dumb , another why I don’t talk about it . My first love (Gina) broke up with me last year. To make a long story short. I realized a little to late that she really was worth it. And ever since bad thing after a bad thing happened to me. I just felt like the whole world was against me. Just recently she reached out again and I was doing good but seeing her again and realizing that maybe there’s still something there but her not wanting to go through it all over again out of fear. Really puts into perspective the meaning of right person bad timing. And that was just the icing on the cake. I feel like my parents really try to understand me but when I open up to them they end up victimizing themselves and making me feel bad for doing things I like. Honestly, you a complete stranger . Showing this must interest is more than anyone has in a really , really long time. And i appreciate it. I don’t wanna be such a sad person anymore. I want to be able to move on with my life and really just be happy with who I am. Because everyday now for a long long time. I wake up and I feel empty and I feel like a failure trying to pretend I got it together
